# World of Warcraft Private Servers

Curated tracker of World of Warcraft private servers: current status for 52 servers, emulation history timeline, private-server news, and Classic+ (Project Camelot) development tracking.

## Key pages

- Home (server list with live status filters): https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/
- News: https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/news/
- Classic+ / Project Camelot tracker: https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/classic-plus/
- OctoWoW setup guide: https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/guides/octowow/
- Expansion lists: https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/vanilla/ , https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/wotlk/ , https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/tbc/ , https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/cataclysm/ , https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/legion/
- Radio: https://wowprivateservers.vercel.app/radio/

## Data

- Servers: status (playable / dev / closed), expansion, details, official site. One page each under /servers/{name}/.
- History: 41 events covering core emulators, web tools, and development milestones.
- News: dated entries, each with a link to the original announcement.

## Curated facts

- No WoW private server is affiliated with or authorized by Blizzard Entertainment.
- Statuses are maintained from Discord community updates and public announcements; last reviewed August 18, 2026.
